edit.takeover.desc.missingChapters: The task record shows the first chapters are ready to write, but the chapter execution area is still empty, meaning the director artifacts weren't fully saved. You can complete the director artifacts directly to keep repairing.
edit.takeover.desc.missingCharacters: The task record shows the book handoff is done, but the project has no character assets yet, so character prep and chapter execution are both incomplete. You can complete the director artifacts directly and the system will keep repairing.
edit.takeover.desc.pendingRecovery: The task is paused at its current progress. You can check the execution details, then resume from the latest progress point.

takeover.checkpoint.replan: Waiting to handle the replan suggestion
takeover.desc.candidateSelection: The book-level direction candidates have been generated. Go back to the direction confirmation page to pick or adjust a plan so the Auto-Director can continue the main chain.
takeover.desc.characterSetup: Character prep has been generated. Review the core characters, relationships, and current goals, then continue the Auto-Director once confirmed.
takeover.desc.completed: The Auto-Director has finished chapter execution, review, and repair for {{scope}}. You can enter chapter execution to keep writing, or finish and exit director mode.
takeover.desc.default: The AI is taking over this book's setup flow in the background. You can keep working on the project manually; if you and the Auto-Director change the same content at once, the latest write wins.
takeover.desc.failed: The background directing flow was interrupted. Check the execution details before deciding whether to resume from the latest progress point.
takeover.desc.failedChapterBatch: Auto-run of {{scope}} is paused. Check the execution details or quality-repair area before deciding whether to continue.
takeover.desc.replan: After running the selected chapter batch, the AI judged that later chapters need replanning. You can enter the quality-repair area to handle the suggestion, or leave this issue for later quality recovery and keep auto-running the following chapters.
takeover.desc.reviewScope: The Auto-Director has reached a review point. Check the current stage's output before deciding whether to continue.
takeover.desc.runningChapterBatch: The AI is auto-running {{scope}} in the background and will keep finishing review and repair. You can still view and edit manually; if you change the current chapter at the same time, later automated results may overwrite that part.
takeover.desc.volumeStrategy: You can now review and fine-tune the volume strategy / skeleton. Confirm it, then continue auto-generating the beat sheet, chapter breakdown, and detailed resources for the selected chapter batch.

takeover.title.volumeStrategy: "{{title}}" is waiting for volume strategy / skeleton review
